biggest_catch: UserTesting has no official contributor referral payout program — its 'Invite Network' is a customer-side testing feature, not a paid refer-a-friend program.
catches: UserTesting's official Invite Network help article describes customers inviting their own contributors to tests — not a contributor referral bonus.
No official UserTesting page states any referral payout for contributors.
Third-party reviewers note there is no UserTesting affiliate scheme or referral program for testers.

c1.evidence: UserTesting — real usability-testing platform; official help on help.usertesting.com.

c2.evidence: No official contributor referral program with payout terms exists; the Invite Network is a B2B testing feature.

c3.evidence: Free for contributors; no participation fee.

c4.evidence: No concrete payout in official terms.

eligibility: None — no official contributor referral program exists.
notes: Catalog claimed 'Bonus per qualifying referral (varies)'. Official UserTesting help (Invite Network FAQ) describes a B2B testing feature, not a paid referral program; no official contributor referral payout terms exist — corrected to reject per the concrete-payout rule.

s1.note: No official contributor referral program exists.

s4.note: No concrete payout stated in official terms.
